note: OWCS Grid puzzles, written by scripts/grid/generate_puzzles.py and served as-is by the API (owcsmuse/grid). A puzzle whose date is today or earlier (UTC) is published and never edited: the generator refuses to, and nobody should by hand. Each cell holds every accepted player id with the name and maps-in-role at generation; 'unverifiable' holds, per column, the players seen there with no role on record.
